interest: Monitored broadcasts of Japan's 1942 election show unendorsed candidates like Ozaki Yukio and Saito Takao winning.
overview: This file consists of a 16-page Foreign Broadcast Monitoring Service (FBMS) intelligence report dated May 29, 1942, stamped by the Department of State's Division of Far Eastern Affairs on June 4, 1942, documenting the results of the Japanese Diet general election held on April 30, 1942. The document provides vote counts, candidate classifications (incumbents, former members, new members, and recommended versus non-recommended candidates under the Imperial Rule Assistance system), and unsuccessful runners-up across prefectural electoral districts throughout Japan. Compiled from monitored domestic Japanese-language broadcasts from Tokyo, the report includes 427 of the 466 successful Diet members and 91 unsuccessful candidates, noting transcription and translation variations caused by differing broadcast reception conditions.

subfiles.about: A compilation of election results and successful and unsuccessful candidates in the April 30, 1942 Japanese general election based on monitored domestic radio broadcasts.
subfiles.summary: This report compiles returns from the April 30, 1942 Japanese general election for the House of Representatives as broadcast by Tokyo domestic radio and transcribed by the Foreign Broadcast Monitoring Service. It details 427 of the 466 successful candidates across prefectural districts, noting incumbents, first-time members, former members, and candidate recommendation status by the Imperial Rule Assistance Association. The report also lists 91 unsuccessful runners-up and accounts for phonetic discrepancies and data variations arising from fluctuating radio reception conditions.
subfiles.title: Japanese Diet Members: Results of April 30, General Election (FBMS-136)
subfiles.to: Division of Far Eastern Affairs, Department of State
